name: Ding Tea Escondido
notes: Restaurant's own Clover COLO2 storefront (clover.com/online-ordering link redirects here via coloV2Enabled). Address in payload matches work list (1815 E VALLEY PKWY). Storefront showed serviceHoursState CLOSED but the RSC flight payload still carried the full catalog - the closed-store gate is a front-end decision, not a data restriction. Payload was double-escaped (embedded once for the RSC string, then again for the outer script string) which broke the standard extract_clover_colo2.js brace-balancer on a description containing a literal quote; decoded the JSON-string layer properly first (JSON.parse('"'+chunk+'"')) before brace-balancing, rather than the naive global backslash-quote replace. 110 priced items across 11 categories (Coffee, Flavored Tea, Fresh Tea, Fruit Juice, Hot Drinks, Latte, Macaron, Milk Tea, Shake, Yakult, Yogurt) - full boba-shop section spread, no core section obviously missing. Prices land on conventional .00/.25/.50/.75 endings throughout, no markup pattern (checked 1.04/1.10/1.15/1.20).

name: MOE COFFEE-NORTH PARK
notes: First-party Toast page, address confirmed (4195 Kansas St). Page embeds two parallel price fields per item in __OO_STATE__ (Apollo cache): a clean/round price and a second, higher price on the same MenuItem-named object under the same section (ratios ranged ~1.03-1.34, not a constant fee, e.g. Americano $5.00 vs $6.65, Stash Tea $4.50 vs $4.66). Cross-checked against the rendered HTML (extract_toast3.js output, 21 items) and every one of those matched the LOWER price exactly, including an odd non-round outlier (Traditional Macchiato $6.03) confirming the lower value is what Toast actually displays/charges - so the higher duplicate was treated as a second, non-displayed internal price tier and dropped, not averaged or derived. New technique: __OO_STATE__ items are nested several levels deep inside Menu:<guid>.groups[].items[], not at top level - required a recursive tree walk (collect __typename:MenuItem, track nearest enclosing Menu/MenuGroup name for section) rather than a flat key scan. 71 final deduplicated dishes across 9 sections (Coffee, Smoothies, Other Drinks, Clara's Kitchen Breakfast Sandwiches, Moe's Pastries, Canned Beer, Wine/ Mimosa, 1/2 lbs Coffee, Chips).
